versions.status: sourced from NSE circulars; scope is non-ETF securities in series EQ, BE, BZ, BO, RL, AF and their BL series (T0 follows the same tick as its T+1 series); excludes ETFs; boundary clause in NSE/CMTR/62174: securities with price below Rs 250 have tick Rs 0.01, and if the reference price is less than Rs 250 the tick is Rs 0.01 else the regular Rs 0.05, so exactly Rs 250.00 is Rs 0.05 and Rs 249.99 is Rs 0.01
versions.reference_price_rule: closing price on the last trading day of the previous month, reviewed monthly and applied from the first trading day of the next month; the first determination used the 2024-05-31 close for 2024-06-10; a new listing uses the issue price or the last close three trading days before listing; after a split, bonus, dividend or rights issue the existing tick stands until the next monthly review; the caller supplies this price
sources: NSE/CMTR/62174 Revision in tick size of securities in CM segment, Circular Ref 66/2024, dated 2024-05-24, effective from trade date 2024-06-10: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR62174.pdf (fetched 2026-10-06)
